name: orca-env-generator
description: Model new rigid object types in Blender and export their meshes into MuJoCo; legacy primitive ORCA RL tasks remain available.

interface.shortDescription: Create MuJoCo scenes and RL environments from text or photos
interface.longDescription: Model new rigid objects from tabletop photos with Blender running in the background. Deliver an editable .blend intermediate, then export a mesh-only MuJoCo scene with previews and physics checks. Open Blender only on request.
defaultPrompt: Generate a Blender intermediate and a MuJoCo scene from my photo without opening Blender.
Start a phone photo upload session and show the QR code.
Export my saved Blender intermediate and generate the MuJoCo scene.
Make the ORCA hand close into a fist and open again.
